Behind the image
11 / Ribbon Daydream
REFERENCE 5030.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 013
Art direction: Pale ivory, strawberry red, floral cotton and natural skin detail.
Photorealistic vertical close-up beauty portrait of an original adult woman with long chestnut hair
in two loose braids tied with red patterned ribbon bows, soft freckles across the nose and cheeks,
natural makeup and a gentle, slightly dreamy smile. She wears a delicate cream floral cotton
blouse. Soft diffused daylight, pale ivory background, strawberry-red accents, visible natural skin
texture, nostalgic romantic mood, shallow depth of field, no text or logos.
12 / Brown Study
REFERENCE 5029.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 013
Art direction: Soft editorial light, warm neutrals, vintage-inspired everyday fashion.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter fashion portrait of an original adult woman with loose blonde
waves and soft bangs, calm direct gaze and natural makeup, standing relaxed against a neutral
gray studio backdrop. She wears a fitted brown long-sleeve top, a dark patterned mini skirt and a
narrow belt. Soft editorial light, warm neutral palette, vintage-inspired everyday fashion, crisp
fabric texture, no text or logos.
